sonnet.problem: The question says the swamps and marshes are 'by the Dead Sea'. Verse 11 doesn't say where they are, so this adds a setting the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: **No added settings.** No setting the text doesn't give.

sonnet.problem: Verse 10 is a prediction ('Fishermen will stand… they will spread their nets'). The question asks in the present tense, 'What do they pull in?', as if it were happening now.
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
